nodes.name: GANSSER_cat.txt
nodes.summary: Whitespace-delimited relocated earthquake catalog for the Gansser seismic network (about 900 events, 2013 onward) with event ID, hypocenter, location errors, origin time, local magnitude, RMS, azimuthal gap and station counts.

nodes.name: HIMNT_cat.txt
nodes.summary: Simple earthquake catalog from the HIMNT experiment (about 1600 events from 2001) listing origin time, latitude, longitude and depth in kilometres.

nodes.name: ISC_catalog.txt
nodes.summary: International Seismological Centre event catalogue export (about 5700 lines) with comma-separated origin date/time, location, depth and multiple agency magnitude estimates, preceded by a commented ISC header.
